_schema: Program control file, owned by Coach Claude, edited via GitHub — the app applies it on next launch with no rebuild. Keyed by app id (a11…b27). Per-exercise fields: name (display name — history and Airtable stay keyed to the app id, so renames are safe; when SWAPPING a movement keep the same id and note the swap date in 'note'), sr (the header target label, free text), equipment / setup / execute / note (card copy), and meta {lo, hi, inc, vm, rest, pain, bw, deg, mus} — rep range, weight increment, volume multiplier, rest seconds, elbow-button flag, bodyweight flag, angle flag, muscle list for the heat map. Top-level _order: {"U1": [ids…], "L1": […], "U2": […], "L2": […]} reorders exercises within a session; listed ids come first, unlisted follow in current order. STILL BUILD-ONLY (ask terminal Claude): set counts (meta.n), moving an exercise between sessions, adding/removing exercises. Blank/omitted fields fall back to baked text. Bad JSON is ignored safely.
